cell_line.evidence: Overnight cultures of E. coli MG1665 ∆RM, transformed with plasmids encoding the Zorya operon (or control), were used to inoculate (at a 1:1000 dilution) 3 mL LB media with antibiotics, then grown to an OD600 of approximately 0.4.
